Kindred Restructure says "Choose a new seating order.
Successful referendum means each Methuselah takes
his or her new seat."

Is "the current seating order" a valid "new" seating
order? Or does it mean "new and different"?

referendum means you switch places with that Methuselah."

Is "myself" a valid choice for someone to switch places
with?

Thanks,

Josh

the order would still be the same. Mind you, I've done this sort of
thing in other games in the past just to get a better chair.
